description:
Integrate the agent identity standard (from agent-manager) into swarm-manager so that backlog items, executions, and other resources carry verified provenance information.

## Context

Swarm-manager currently has 'started_by' on execution records but no provenance tracking on backlog items themselves. When agents create or modify backlog items via the CLI, there's no way to distinguish agent-created items from human-created ones, or to trace which specific agent run produced a change.

App-issue-tracker had a reporter field (name, email, user_id, timestamp) on every issue. Rather than copying that pattern directly, we're building on the cross-scenario identity standard so provenance is verifiable rather than self-reported.

## Expected Deliverables

1. **CLI identity detection**: Swarm-manager CLI reads the VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN env var using the shared consumer package from packages/cli-core. When present, the CLI includes the token in API requests (e.g., as a header or request field).

2. **API token verification**: When the swarm-manager API receives a request with an identity token, it verifies the token against agent-manager's verification endpoint. On success, it extracts provenance claims (run_id, task_id, profile_key, etc.).

3. **Backlog item provenance**: Add a 'created_by' field to spec.json that records either 'operator' (for human-created items) or verified agent identity claims (run_id, profile_key, timestamp). This field is set at creation time and immutable.

4. **Execution record provenance**: Enhance the existing execution record to link verified agent identity (beyond the current 'started_by' string).

5. **UI provenance display**: Surface provenance information in the UI - show who/what created a backlog item, with visual distinction between operator-created and agent-created items. Show the originating run link for agent-created items.

6. **Graceful fallback**: When no identity token is present (human operator, or agent-manager hasn't been updated yet), default to 'operator' attribution. Never fail a request due to missing identity.

7. **Tests**: Unit tests for token detection and verification in the CLI and API. Integration tests for the full provenance flow.
name: swarm-manager-identity-adoption
title: Adopt Agent Identity Standard in Swarm-Manager for Provenance Tracking
